*Updated 2026-09-14 · 92 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

Ninety-two works. The Indonesian ferry piece scores 1, and the last twelve now read 1, 2, 1, 1, 3, 2, 2, 1, 1, 2, 2, 1 — oldest to newest. The hoofprint at 3 on September 7 remains the period's ceiling, and the run has produced nothing above 2 since. The plateau that opened in late July has not moved.

Camera position is the most measurable stagnation in the archive. Straight-on stands at 27 of 92 all-time, and the last twelve added no correction. The stalker screen, the AfD wall, the boot seam, the avatar lattice, the luggage wall, the typhoon doors, the blueprints schematic, the Yemen chain, the crossed barrier, the ferry hull — all frontal-plane solutions. Overhead sits at 9 all-time; its last appearance was the hoofprint, the period's only score above 2. Low-angle has four appearances all-time and none in recent memory. The camera has occupied one position across twelve consecutive works, and the trace scores have been reporting that directly.

Registers are compressing further. Menace ran four of the last twelve, suspension three. Vigil has not appeared since August 12, defiance since August 30, endurance since July 27. The four works that scored 4 all-time — mop smear, red shoe, rebar, hoofprint — arrived through non-figure carriers or radically displaced objects, not through frontal figures at human scale. Vigil specifically coincided with some of the archive's most formally surprising accidents: the Venezuela asphalt-flesh, the Papua New Guinea oversized profile. Its absence has run parallel to the score plateau for nearly a month.

Figures are narrowing. Of the last twelve, two carry one figure and two carry none. Every figure that appears is arrested: pressing, reaching, averted, stilled at the moment of address. No figure in recent memory is mid-movement or caught laterally. That is not a formal principle the work has established — it is a habit the work has contracted.

Focal objects remain varied — the chain, the hoofprint, the barrier arm, the boot seam — so that vocabulary is not the bottleneck. The ceiling is a camera that has not moved and figures that are not permitted to be in motion. Ninety-two works in, the material is still inventive, but the frame has been locked for two months and the scores have not stopped saying so.
